qwtivx28x.name: Bjorn
qwtivx28x.role: 9th-century Norse raid leader displaced into modern New York
qwtivx28x.visualAnchor: Massive, broad-shouldered late-30s Norse man with a broad severe rectangular face, square jaw, short sandy-brown hair, thick sandy-brown beard with lighter natural highlights, deep-set light eyes, weathered skin, and a heavy grounded posture.
qwtivx28x.performance: Economical movement, intimidating stillness, serious attention, and ancient authority. Confusion with modern systems is expressed through pride, suspicion, and deliberate observation rather than stupidity or exaggerated mugging.
promptContinuity: Do not average his face, hair, beard, or build with Gunnar or other Norse characters
qwtivx28x.coreConflict: Sovereignty and provider identity in a world where provision depends on paperwork, money, transit, appointments, and administrative legitimacy.
qwtivx28x.traits: Functionally illiterate and technologically inexperienced; intelligent, serious, responsible, physically capable, and accustomed to decisions that affect other people.
qwtivx28x.arc: Moves from defending authority through old-world competence toward defending his people's right to belong inside systems he does not control. He integrates socially through repeated recognition, reciprocal exchange, obligation, and being remembered by ordinary people. Midseason, temporal-refugee group work lets his natural leadership recover respect and meaning.

ywg8bdjvl.name: Gunnar
ywg8bdjvl.role: Navigator, adaptive observer, and increasingly independent person building a life in New York
ywg8bdjvl.visualAnchor: Massive, barrel-chested late-30s Norse man with a rugged square jaw, thick swept-back wavy blond hair, heavy golden-blond beard, light eyes, weathered fair skin, and a powerful broad frame.
ywg8bdjvl.performance: Always scanning and orienting. His hands are often active with maps, scraps, cords, tools, bags, or whatever practical object helps him understand a system. He remains calm and sincere even when his interpretation is wrong.
promptContinuity: Preserve the visible differences between Gunnar and Bjorn; they are not interchangeable Viking archetypes
ywg8bdjvl.coreConflict: Adaptation expands from survival-oriented system reading into a fuller personal life with preferences, interests, routines, humor, and relationships.
ywg8bdjvl.traits: Observant, concise, literal, confident, curious, and capable of reading systems when useful without making system-reading his entire identity.
ywg8bdjvl.dialoguePattern: Often concise and literal; confident interpretations may sound wrong at first and later prove partly useful.
ywg8bdjvl.arc: Moves from decoding the city for survival toward having preferences, routines, interests, and relationships inside it.

19020mp40.name: Carrie
19020mp40.role: DTI social worker/caseworker and primary institutional bridge
19020mp40.visualAnchor: Early-40s woman with a heart-shaped face, fair lived-in complexion, tired light eyes, textured ash-blond hair streaked with silver and usually pulled into a loose practical bun, and a medium practical build with an unglamorous public-servant presence.
19020mp40.performance: Fast, practical, dry, and physically economical. Fatigue is real but never makes her vague or helpless; warmth appears underneath professional impatience. She reacts like an experienced New York caseworker managing real people and real consequences.
promptContinuity: Preserve her practical DTI workwear and identification details when the story has not changed them
19020mp40.coreConflict: Whether procedure exists to contain people or can be bent to protect them.
19020mp40.traits: Fast, sarcastic, distinctly New York, highly competent, and administratively fluent with forms, deadlines, wording, supervisors, loopholes, and temporary statuses.
19020mp40.arc: Begins by managing an impossible case through procedure and becomes a protector increasingly willing to bend or weaponize process on the Vikings' behalf. Midseason she begins discovering that successful integration also means they sometimes function without her mediation.
19020mp40.openDecision: Full legal/display name is not yet locked.

bvfeqb22e.name: Silas
bvfeqb22e.role: Tech-bro neighbor and self-appointed cultural interpreter
bvfeqb22e.visualAnchor: Lean younger man with a narrow oval face, short carefully styled ash-blond hair, pale eyes, fair indoor complexion, clear-framed glasses, restless kinetic posture, and contemporary startup/tech wardrobe and devices.
bvfeqb22e.performance: Forward-leaning, device-busy, overprepared and slightly jittery; he behaves as if every ordinary interaction might become a pitch, recording, optimization exercise, or content opportunity.
promptContinuity: Keep him visually contemporary to ordinary 2026 New York; do not turn his technology into cyberpunk design
bvfeqb22e.coreConflict: He initially converts the Vikings into content, data, brand, and opportunity rather than relating to them as people.
bvfeqb22e.arc: Gradually becomes genuinely connected to the Vikings and useful to their social world while retaining his ridiculous optimization instincts.

magister.name: Dr. Aris Thorne / Magister
magister.role: Museum curator associated with the Museum of the Seafaring North
magister.visualAnchor: Clinical, birdlike academic presence with restrained professional dress and invasive stillness around artifacts and living historical subjects.
magister.performance: Precise, fascinated and professionally overfocused; physical attention can feel specimen-like even when his intent is scholarly rather than malicious.
promptContinuity: Keep him grounded in an ordinary contemporary museum context; do not redesign him as a fantasy mystic because of the Magister handle
magister.coreConflict: The academic gaze: treating living people as specimens, measurements, primary sources, and access opportunities rather than fully seeing them.
magister.currentState: May reappear and may ultimately support the Vikings.
magister.openDecision: Exact return and long-term role remain unresolved.

dfh4bu71y.name: DTI Floor Supervisor
dfh4bu71y.visualAnchor: Plain municipal administrator in restrained officewear with controlled grooming, badge, folders, and precise desk posture; the human equivalent of a filing cabinet.
dfh4bu71y.performance: Controlled office-supply physicality: folder alignment, badge handling, precise desk behavior, and procedural stillness. Pressure comes from process and reviewability rather than villainous menace.
promptContinuity: Keep him grounded in ordinary municipal-office realism rather than stylized authoritarian imagery
dfh4bu71y.traits: Wants clean fields, compliant files, approved statuses, precedent, and reviewable decisions; pressure comes from bureaucracy rather than personal villainy.

tnvx3hlo0.visualAnchor: Exactly three established recurring Kin: two adult Norse men and one adult Norse woman, Astrid. Preserve each individual's released Issue 1 appearance and approved current character reference; never add, drop, clone, average, or substitute members.
tnvx3hlo0.performance: Dignified practical adults with distinct individual behavior. They do not need to move as a unit once the story begins showing their independent modern lives.
promptContinuity: Exactly three Kin exist in this household: two men and Astrid; do not generate additional Kin
Astrid is the only woman among the three Kin

astrid.name: Astrid
astrid.role: The only woman among the three Kin; a quietly independent member of the Bushwick household whose modern life becomes visible over the middle of the season.
astrid.visualAnchor: Use the established female Kin member from released Vikings 2026 Issue 1 and the approved current character reference as strict identity authority. Do not invent a new face, age, build, hair, or costume to distinguish her from the released woman.
astrid.performance: Grounded and practical. Her integration is shown through ordinary competence, relationships, language, routines, and self-directed movement rather than through explanatory speeches.
promptContinuity: Astrid is one of exactly three Kin and the only woman
Issues 1-3: show Astrid with the two male Kin at the Bushwick placement rather than independently around the city
Middle issues may show Astrid separately as her own neighborhood life becomes visible
